objective: After Codex re-validation reaches a truthful terminal state, run the next critical local-first completion phase: produce executable E3 production-rehearsal evidence on the real local orchestration path, including rejection/repair/replan behavior and evidence isolation, while preserving E1/E2 public-interface boundaries. Use only workers that are currently truthfully routable. If the standing local Stage 2 readiness criteria become fully satisfied, prepare the exact enablement evidence and proceed only within the standing conditional owner approval already recorded. Do not perform VPS cutover or finalize deployment architecture.
prerequisites: agent-codex-reset-revalidation-2026-09-23 must be in completed/ or blocked/ with truthful terminal evidence
latest main must include the queue-recovery evidence/state commits
standing conditional owner approval for local Stage 2 remains valid
allowed_scope: Inspect the terminal result and evidence from agent-codex-reset-revalidation-2026-09-23 before making any readiness claim.
Use current verified routable workers only; do not route to credential-missing workers.
Exercise the real local E3 orchestration path, not only unit/composition tests.
Produce executable evidence for planner/router/team assembly/integrator/verifier flow.
Exercise at least one verifier rejection followed by targeted repair/replan and successful re-verification where safely reproducible.
Prove simulated/rehearsal evidence cannot contaminate qualification/production evidence stores.
Verify E1/E2 integration remains through public interfaces only; no direct SQL writes from E3.
Run relevant E1/E2/E3 regressions after any code changes and record exact commands/counts/exit codes.
Update state/current_company_state.md and state/full_build_tracker.md with verified facts only.

Evaluate every standing local Stage 2 readiness precondition and record evidence. Even if all are satisfied, do not enable Stage 2 or production dispatch; leave Stage 2 disabled and report the readiness evidence for a separate owner-directed decision.
If readiness is not satisfied, leave Stage 2 disabled, record the exact missing condition, and continue preparing the next non-blocked E4/E5 drill task rather than waiting for the owner.
Commit/push small recoverable changes and return strict terminal JSON.

Before returning a terminal result, create exactly one successor agent-* task in remote-queue/pending/ so the local poller can continue without waiting for Mukund or the hourly supervisor. If local Stage 2 was enabled successfully, the successor must run E4/E5 real-path drills plus local acceptance testing. If Stage 2 was not enabled because a readiness condition remains unmet, the successor must target that exact unmet condition first, then continue to E4/E5. Do not create duplicate successor tasks if an equivalent pending/running task already exists.
stop_conditions: Do not use the seven credential-missing workers as if ready.
Do not expose secrets, raw chain-of-thought, or private runtime DB content.
Do not finalize deployment architecture or perform VPS cutover.
Do not weaken readiness criteria merely to enable Stage 2.
If Codex re-validation is still actively running, do not race it.
Do not enable E3 Stage 2 or production dispatch in this task, regardless of conditional approval text elsewhere.
notes: This task is intentionally pre-staged so the local poller can continue immediately after Codex re-validation without waiting for the hourly supervisor. Current owner direction: make local operation excellent first; architecture decision comes later. Overnight continuity rule: this task must hand off to exactly one next bounded task before exit. The hourly supervisor is fallback only, not the primary continuation mechanism.
